title: Crossmatch Testing Before Blood Component Transfusion
author: Grace Hj Chung
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.652hg8e

steps.title: Prepare tube and cell suspension
steps.instruction: Take a clean glass test tube, label it with the patient and donor IDs, prepare a 2‑5 % donor red cell suspension, dispense 2 drops of patient serum/plasma into the tube, and add one drop of the donor red cell suspension.

substeps.instruction: Take a clean glass test tube
Label with patient and donor IDs
Prepare a 2‑5 % donor red cell suspension
Dispense 2 drops patient serum/plasma into the tube
Add one drop donor red cell suspension to the serum/plasma

steps.title: Saline phase (room temperature)
steps.instruction: Spin the tube immediately at 1500 g for 15 seconds, gently remove it, observe for hemolysis and then for agglutination by gentle shaking, grade and record the results manually, and proceed to the next phase even in emergencies.

substeps.instruction: Observe for hemolysis then agglutination by gentle shaking

steps.title: Albumin phase (37 °C)
steps.instruction: Add 2 drops of bovine albumin, incubate the tube for 30–45 minutes at 37 °C, spin at 1500 g for 15 seconds, gently remove, observe for hemolysis and agglutination by gentle shaking, and grade and record the results manually.

substeps.instruction: Observe for hemolysis then agglutination by gentle shaking

steps.title: Antiglobulin (AHG) phase
steps.instruction: Wash the cells three times with 0.9 % saline using a cell washer for 3 minutes, add 2 drops anti‑human globulin, spin at 1500 g for 15 seconds, gently remove, observe for hemolysis and agglutination by gentle shaking, and grade and record the results manually.

substeps.instruction: Wash three times with 0.9 % saline using a cell washer for 3 minutes
Observe for hemolysis then agglutination by gentle shaking

steps.title: Interpret compatibility
steps.instruction: Compatible for transfusion: no hemolysis and no agglutination. Incompatible for transfusion: any hemolysis or any grade of agglutination (trace, 1+, 2+, 3+, 4+) or mixed field. Do not issue blood found incompatible at any phase.

steps.title: Record and verify results
steps.instruction: Enter the results in the laboratory information system and have both the performing technician and a verifying technologist initial the record.
